# Contributing

## Development setup

Install [mise](https://mise.jdx.dev/getting-started.html) 2026.9.0 or newer.
The root [mise.toml](../mise.toml) declares the CLI versions and host packages:

```bash
mise trust
mise install
```

On a Mac that also needs OrbStack and Tailscale, preview and install the host
packages with `mise bootstrap --dry-run` and `mise bootstrap`. Existing app
bundles are adopted. OrbStack supplies Docker, Compose, and `orbctl`; macOS
supplies the standard Unix tools and Zsh. App permissions and sign-in remain
interactive. Docker Desktop is also supported when installed separately.

Linux CI runners provide Docker and Compose. Mise installs their additional
Zsh package. CI and runner setup with `--install-deps` use this same manifest.

Clone the repository and work from its root. Copy the relevant example
environment file before running services locally. Never commit resolved
credentials, private hostnames, IP addresses, tailnet names, telemetry data,
backups, queues, or machine-specific environment files.

Enable the project-local hooks with:

```bash
mise exec -- ./ops/scripts/setup.sh
```

The setup script installs hooks in `.git/hooks/` and preserves existing local
hooks. Pass `--refresh` only when updating hooks previously generated by hnet.

## Workflow

1. Create a focused branch.
2. Make the smallest coherent change.
3. Preserve the privacy rules in [the README](../README.md#data-and-privacy).
4. Run the validation commands below.
5. Open a pull request describing the change and its operational impact.

## Style

- Keep shell functions short and single-purpose.
- Prefer immutable values and early returns.
- Quote shell expansions and fail securely.
- Keep deployment configuration explicit and host-neutral.
- Update documentation when behavior or operations change.

## Validation

<!-- validation commands and collector configuration checks from ops/scripts/validate.sh -->

```bash
mise exec -- ./ops/scripts/lint.sh --strict
mise exec -- tests/ops/apps/hnetctl/hnetctl_test.sh
mise exec -- ./ops/scripts/validate.sh
```

Validation parses both complete collector configurations with the pinned
collector image and example environment files. These disposable containers
have networking disabled. To run only this check:

```bash
mise exec -- ./ops/scripts/validate.sh --collectors
```

## Pull requests

Keep pull requests focused, link related issues, and include validation results.
Call out changes to deployment, retention, redaction, permissions, or backup
behavior explicitly.
